Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

each month a retailer sells 100 identical items . on each item he makes a profit of $ 40 that constitutes 10 % of the item ' s price to the retailer . if the retailer contemplates giving a 5 % discount on the items he sells , what is the least number of items he will have to sell each month to justify the policy of the discount ?

A. 191
B. 213
C. 221
D. 223
E. 226

message.content:
Price = cost + 40, with 40 = 10% of price → price 400... but using cost 400, price 440, discount 5% → 418, profit 18. Need 4000/18 ≈ 222.2 → 223 items.

ANSWER: D
